annotations.title: List closures, days off and blocked time

description: Use this when someone asks when their salon is closed or has extra opening hours, or when a stylist or chair is blocked for holidays, vacations, sick days, training or meetings. Returns blocks and extra openings with salon, type, scope, effect, all-day flag and times for all salons unless one is given, earliest first (no titles or notes). Not for client appointments.

endTime.description: Only events ending before this ISO 8601 time

limit.description: Maximum number of calendar events to return (default 20, maximum 100)

salonId.description: Only blocks for this salon, by an id from the user's salon list; every salon when absent

startTime.description: Only events starting at or after this ISO 8601 time

name: list_calendar_events

events.description: Closures, days off and extra openings, earliest first. Free-text titles and notes, chair ids, staff ids, organization data and private reasons are excluded.

effect.description: BLOCK removes bookable time; OPEN adds hours on a normally closed time

scope.description: SALON: the whole salon; PROVIDER: one or more stylists; CHAIR: one chair

title: List closures, days off and blocked time
